plan: A pirate who chain-detonates his powder kegs and bombards the whole map.
aSurveiller: His kegs (E). He detonates them in a chain from a distance: stay away from kegs, even if they seem far from him.
contrer: Destroy his kegs (E) when they are weak: it stops him from using them.
Never stand near a keg: the explosions chain.
Engage him early: he is fragile in the early game.
forces: Huge area damage with his kegs.
His R hits anywhere on the map.
Removes crowd control with his W.

sorts.Q: Shot that gives gold if it kills.
sorts.E: Keg that explodes when he hits it.
sorts.R: Bombards an area anywhere on the map.

momentFort: Weak early, very strong in the late game.
